caveats.message: The bundled GTE provisioned value is 20 DBU/hour, matching Azure Learn. The current Databricks foundation page publishes 100 DBU/hour per 50 model units. Suppress an unqualified operational dollar quote until the offering, cloud, and unit basis are reconciled; the existing forecast table is unchanged.

Current Foundation Model Serving provisioned figures are quoted per 50 model units per hour. Throughput per model unit varies with model and request shape. Cayfore's legacy forecast accepts provisioned hours without an explicit model-unit count; do not present that input as a universal endpoint-hour tariff or a throughput guarantee.

The bundled flat AI Search storage prices of $0.23/GB-month standard and $0.046/GB-month optimized are curated assumptions across clouds. Azure Learn describes AI Search storage as 10 DSU, which would be $0.26 at the stored East US DSU price. The standard 30 GB allowance is a bundled assumption. Neither storage number is freshly verified as a universal tariff.

Cayfore does not model every route, endpoint, public-connectivity, or private-connectivity tariff. A current Databricks page links an official table effective 2024-08-01, while current documents differ on endpoint-hour billing timing. Missing bundled charges mean unknown or excluded, not free or that no public price exists. Azure's specific Data Processed meter must not be applied to every private-link or egress route.

Forecast rules use Azure Jobs 2.5x, All-Purpose 2x, and classic pipelines 2.9x DBU emission; AWS/GCP Jobs retain a 2.9x planning factor. Exact instance ratings can differ. These multiply consumption, not dollars per DBU, and are separate from a runtime speedup. The generic product note saying Jobs always uses 2.9x is not the engine's complete rule.

The forecast's 10% compliance and 30% Mission Critical settings are planning assumptions on workspace spend. They are not the same unit as East US API meters of $0.10/DBU and $0.15/DBU. Do not convert the percentages into a single official per-unit tariff or add another product charge for the same usage.

The 150 DBU monthly allowance applies to users, excluding service principals. Genie One and Agents user usage is free through 2027-01-31; Code usage above the allowance remains billable. The 25% billed-usage promotion is reflected in DBU metering, so imported billed DBUs must not receive it again. Connected SQL and other services cost extra. Unit rates show the underlying list basis, not a universal free user or per-question price.

The curated eight-model table omits many current models, cache reads/writes, priority or batch offerings, reservations, context bands, and residency uplifts. A zero or absent output-token conversion for embeddings means the output dimension is not offered in this model, not a free generation service. Evaluation and agent examples do not establish the complete current service tariff.

A missing rate, zero placeholder, unsupported cloud, or learning-only foundation has no independent trustworthy quote. Use null for unavailable prices and explain underlying billable products. A stored price does not guarantee product availability in the selected region. Zero is reserved for a documented free, included, or eligible promotional component.

Use an exact Azure regional meter or validated Databricks price-card/calculator USD/DBU observation when available. Otherwise a captured reference base or legacy secondary value may be scaled by a regional planning factor. A source without regional scope does not establish an exact local price. True first-party disagreements withhold a qualified quote. No price or factor establishes service availability.

Unit-cost rows describe bundled USD list-price bases before negotiated discounts, commitments, tax, and separately billed components. Reviewed source pages and stored-rate dates are separate provenance facts. Customer system-table prices must be joined on SKU, cloud, currency, unit, and effective interval; contract overrides remain separate.

The official monitoring page advertises 50% off displayed pricing through 2027-01-31. Rows expose list-price bases; eligibility, metering and contract treatment must be checked before applying a promotion. Do not discount imported billed DBUs or costs twice.

The official Lakeflow Connect page advertises the first 100 DBUs free per workspace per day. A monthly aggregate alone cannot reproduce this daily allowance. Quantity calculations use already billable usage after applicable allowances; source list prices do not mean every consumed DBU is charged.
